title: Operations New Scraper Entry Permission Consistency

items.action: open and select generic operation creation entries
open and select the Scraper new-operation entry

backend.reason: Scraper immediate create/start authorization already uses fair_crm.scraper.execute.

api.reason: No API contract changes; wizard metadata and operation-type reads already use existing read access.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The Scraper wizard route already uses fair_crm.scraper.execute; this change aligns the Operations-page entry point.

forms.reason: No business form behavior changes; the existing type-picker permission filter is reused.

notes: A user with fair_crm.scraper.execute can reach the Scraper wizard from /operations without also needing fair_crm.operations.create. Enrichment continues to use fair_crm.scraper.execute, Bulk Email continues to use fair_crm.fair_emails.execute, and generic operation entries continue to require fair_crm.operations.create. The existing type picker filters entries through the same fail-closed permission predicate used by onContinue.
